checklist.step: Fix the mandatory content of the profile and intention sheet
actions: List the mandatory fields: purpose of cover, who is to be protected and against what, required benefit amount and term, premium the customer can sustain, and the customer's stated priority between protection and accumulation.

Add the specified-contract fields for variable annuities: age, income and asset position, investment experience by product type, tolerance for principal loss, and intended holding period against the surrender charge period.
Mark which fields block submission if blank and which permit a recorded 'declined to answer'.
Have Regulatory Counsel confirm the field set satisfies Art. 294-2 intention confirmation and the specified-contract suitability rules.
checklist.done: a counsel-confirmed field list exists, marking blocking fields and permitted refusals separately.

checklist.step: Route any change to the form through the Art. 123 basic-document gate
actions: Determine for each proposed change whether it amends the statement of business procedures, the policy conditions, or the premium and reserve calculation methods.
Classify the change as requiring prior FSA authorisation under Art. 123 or as a notification-only item under Art. 125, citing the ordinance provision that supports the classification.
Prepare the amendment application with the before-and-after text and the reason for the change, and submit through the FSA electronic application and notification system.
Record the acknowledgement number and the authorisation date on the form version row and hold the release until it is present.
checklist.done: the form version row carries a classification with citation and an FSA authorisation or notification acknowledgement before release.

checklist.step: Version-control the form and publish it to the field
actions: Stamp the approved form with a version number and effective date in the footer of every page.
Publish it to the agent and broker portal and to the tablet application capture, and withdraw the superseded version on the same date.
Confirm the superseded version can no longer be opened or printed from the portal.
Retain every superseded version with its in-force date range so a historic capture can be matched to the form actually used.
checklist.done: the new version is live, the old one is withdrawn on the same date, and the version history shows in-force date ranges.

checklist.step: Capture the profile before any product is named
actions: Open the customer record and complete the intention sheet before opening any product illustration — the system blocks illustration launch until the sheet is saved.
Read each question aloud to the customer and enter their words, not a paraphrase, into the free-text purpose field.
Where the customer declines to answer a permitted field, record the refusal and the reason rather than leaving the field blank.
Save the sheet; the system stamps the capture time, the producer code and the form version in force.
checklist.done: a saved intention sheet exists with a capture timestamp, producer code and form version, before any illustration was opened.

checklist.step: Capture the additional profile a variable annuity demands
actions: For any specified insurance contract, complete the investment experience grid: products previously held, years of experience and approximate amounts.
Record the customer's financial position — annual income band, liquid assets, and the proportion of liquid assets the proposed premium represents.
Record the stated tolerance for loss of principal and the intended holding period, and compare the holding period to the contract's surrender charge schedule.
Flag for supervisory review any case where the premium exceeds the concentration guideline for the customer's liquid assets or the holding period is shorter than the surrender charge period.
checklist.done: the specified-contract section is complete and any concentration or holding-period conflict is flagged for supervisory review.

checklist.step: Confirm the captured profile back to the customer
actions: Read the completed sheet back to the customer and correct anything they dispute before signature.
Send the sheet for signature or capture an in-person e-signature with a timestamp.
Give the customer a copy immediately and record the delivery method and time.
Where the customer amends an answer at this point, keep both versions rather than overwriting the first.
checklist.done: a signed, timestamped sheet exists, a copy is with the customer, and any amendment retains the original answer.

checklist.step: Re-confirm intention at application, not just at first meeting
actions: At application submission, display the earlier intention sheet alongside the product actually applied for.
Confirm with the customer that the applied-for product still matches the stated intention and record the confirmation with a fresh timestamp.
Where the product no longer matches, send the case back to the producer for a documented explanation rather than accepting it.
Attach both the original sheet and the re-confirmation to the application record.
checklist.done: every application carries a dated re-confirmation that the product matches the earlier stated intention.

checklist.step: Block submission where the profile is incomplete
actions: Configure the new business validation to reject any application without a linked profile whose capture timestamp precedes the illustration timestamp.
Reject on any blocking field left blank and on any specified-contract application missing the investment experience grid.
Return the rejection to the producer with the named missing field, not a generic error.
Log every rejection so repeat offenders surface in the producer scorecard.
checklist.done: applications failing the profile validation are rejected with the named missing field and the rejection is logged.

checklist.step: Handle the customer who will not provide the information
actions: Where a customer declines the specified-contract financial information, record the refusal on the sheet with the date.
Apply the rule that a variable annuity recommendation cannot proceed on a refused financial position — the case moves to execution-only handling or stops.
Have the producer record what was said to the customer about why the information matters.
Route refusal cases to the Annuity Suitability Analyst for a decision before the application is accepted.
checklist.done: every refusal is recorded, routed for decision, and no recommendation proceeds on a refused financial position.

checklist.step: Match every historic capture to the form version then in force
actions: Load the form version history with in-force date ranges into the warehouse alongside the capture records.
Join capture timestamp to version date range and flag any capture made on a version not in force at that time.
Publish the mismatch report weekly to the Producer Compliance Manager.
Treat a capture on a withdrawn version as a control failure in the portal, not a producer error.
checklist.done: a weekly report identifies every capture made on a form version not in force at the capture time.

checklist.step: Train the field on the current form and its blocking rules
actions: Publish a short module on each form version release covering what changed, why, and which fields now block submission.
Make completion mandatory before the producer's next specified-contract sale and enforce it through the portal.
Track completion by producer code and chase non-completers weekly.
Keep the module and its completion records with the form version history.
checklist.done: every producer selling specified contracts has completed the module for the version in force.

checklist.step: Monitor capture quality, not just capture presence
actions: Report weekly on completion rate, refusal rate, average free-text length in the purpose field and the share of sheets that are identical across a producer's cases.
Investigate any producer whose purpose text is templated across customers — identical wording is a capture failure even when the field is populated.
Investigate refusal rates materially above the channel average.
Feed findings into the producer scorecard and the supervision plan.
checklist.done: weekly quality metrics are published and every templated-text or high-refusal producer has an open investigation.

checklist.step: Remediate the customer where the profile was missed
actions: For any policy issued without a valid pre-dated profile, contact the policyholder and complete the profile retrospectively, recording that it is a remediation.
Re-test the sold product against the completed profile and, where it does not fit, offer cancellation with premium return or a switch, with the offer in writing.
Record the customer's decision and complete it within 20 business days.
Never back-date the remediation capture to look like an original.
checklist.done: every missed profile has a retrospective capture, a re-test, a written customer offer and a completed decision within 20 business days.

checklist.step: Report profile control performance to the compliance committee
actions: Table quarterly the completion rate by channel, the form version compliance rate, the exception count and the remediation outcomes.
Name the channels and producers driving the exceptions rather than reporting a company average.
Record the committee's directed actions with owners and due dates.
Escalate to the Board any quarter with an unauthorised form version in field use.
checklist.done: the committee minute records channel-level performance, named drivers and directed actions with owners.

checklist.step: Retain the profile evidence for the contract's life
actions: File the signed sheet, the capture metadata and the form version identifier against the policy number.
Apply the retention label of contract life plus 5 years so the record survives the policy.
Confirm retrieval by policy number, producer code and capture date works in a single search.
Link the record to any remediation case raised against the same policy.
checklist.done: the profile record is filed against the policy number, labelled for contract life plus 5 years and retrievable in one search.

testing.step: Build the population of applications requiring a profile
actions: Extract every application submitted in the quarter for variable annuity and other specified insurance contracts, with producer code, channel, submission date and policy number.
Add applications withdrawn or declined after submission so failures cannot hide behind a non-issue.
Reconcile the extract count to the new business production report for the quarter and clear differences before sampling.
Sign and date the population extract.
testing.done: the population reconciles to the new business production report and includes withdrawn and declined cases.

testing.step: Reconcile every application to a profile record
actions: Join the application population to the profile capture table on policy or opportunity id.
List applications with no profile at all as automatic exceptions.
For matched rows, compare capture timestamp to the first illustration timestamp and list any capture that is later.
Report both lists with counts by channel and producer.
testing.done: every application is matched to a pre-dated profile or listed as an exception, with counts by channel and producer.

testing.step: Draw a documented sample of applications
actions: Take 100% of applications from producers with any exception in the prior quarter and 100% of flagged concentration or holding-period conflicts.
Take 30 further applications at random with a recorded seed across all channels, minimum 50 in total.
Record population size, seed, sample size and selection date so the draw can be repeated.
Ensure every channel with production in the quarter appears in the sample.
testing.done: the sample is reproducible, covers every channel and includes all repeat-offender and flagged cases.

testing.step: Re-perform the completeness assessment on each sampled profile
actions: Open each sampled profile and check every mandatory field against the counsel-confirmed field list without looking at the producer's own compliance flag.
For specified contracts, check the investment experience grid, income and asset bands, loss tolerance and intended holding period are all present.
Read the purpose free text and judge whether it records the customer's own words or a template.
Record a pass or fail per field group with the reason.
testing.done: each sampled profile has an independent field-by-field assessment with a reason recorded for every fail.

testing.step: Trace each sampled capture to the form version in force
actions: Read the form version identifier stored with each sampled capture.
Open the version history and confirm that version was in force on the capture date.
For every version used in the period, open the Art. 123 authorisation or Art. 125 notification acknowledgement and confirm its date precedes the version's go-live date.
A version used in the field before its acknowledgement date is a reportable breach, not a test exception.
testing.done: every sampled capture used an in-force version and every version in the period has a pre-dated FSA acknowledgement.

testing.step: Verify the signature and customer copy evidence
actions: Open the envelope for each sampled sheet and read the signing certificate: signer identity, signature timestamp and IP or in-person capture method.
Confirm the signature timestamp is on or after the capture timestamp and before the application submission.
Confirm a copy was delivered to the customer and the delivery method and time are recorded.
A signature timestamp preceding the capture timestamp indicates a pre-signed blank and is an automatic fail.
testing.done: each sampled sheet has a coherent signature-then-submission timeline and evidenced customer delivery.

testing.step: Test the re-confirmation at application
actions: For each sampled application, open the re-confirmation record and compare the product applied for to the stated intention.
Where the product diverges, confirm a documented explanation exists and was accepted by a supervisor, not by the producer.
Confirm the re-confirmation timestamp sits between the profile capture and the submission.
A missing or auto-generated re-confirmation with no customer interaction evidence is an exception.
testing.done: every sampled application has a timestamped re-confirmation and any product divergence is supervisor-explained.

testing.step: Recompute the concentration and holding-period tests
actions: For each sampled specified-contract case, recompute premium as a percentage of the recorded liquid assets and compare it to the concentration guideline.
Compare the recorded intended holding period to the contract's surrender charge period from the product specification.
Confirm every case breaching either test was actually flagged and reviewed before acceptance.
An unflagged breach is an exception even if the case was ultimately suitable.
testing.done: both tests recompute for every sampled specified-contract case and every breach was flagged before acceptance.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise one case per exception with the policy number, producer code, channel and the specific failure.
Assign a root cause from the fixed list: profile absent, captured after illustration, blocking field blank, templated free text, withdrawn form version, re-confirmation missing.
Name an owner and a remediation date, and open customer remediation where a policy was issued on an absent or invalid profile.
Carry every open case into the next quarter's test as a mandatory retest row.
testing.done: each exception has a case, a root cause, an owner, a remediation date and, where a policy issued, a customer remediation.

testing.step: Conclude, obtain independent sign-off and report
actions: Compute the exception rate by channel and producer against the zero-tolerance threshold for a missing or late profile.
State the conclusion — effective, effective with exceptions, or ineffective — with workpaper references.
Have the reviewer, who sits outside Distribution and manages no sampled producer, sign and date the workpaper.
Report to the Compliance Committee at its next sitting, escalate any unauthorised form version to the Board, and file the workpaper in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper states exception rates by channel, a conclusion and the committee reporting date.

checklist.step: Define what the best-interest test actually decides
actions: Write the test as a fixed set of questions: does the product meet the stated purpose, is the cost justified against a simpler alternative, can the customer sustain the premium, does the term fit the stated horizon, and is the customer able to bear the investment risk.
Define the decision codes: approved, approved with condition, referred to supervisor, declined.
State that a recommendation is not in the customer's best interest merely because it is suitable — a cheaper product meeting the same need must be considered and the comparison recorded.
Have Regulatory Counsel confirm the test against the information-provision and intention-confirmation duties and the customer-oriented conduct principles.
checklist.done: a counsel-confirmed question set and decision code list is published and in use on the desk.

checklist.step: Publish the reserved basis behind every illustrated guarantee
actions: For each in-scope product, extract the Art. 116 policy reserve method as stated in the filed basic documents: valuation method, valuation interest rate and mortality table.
Mark which products fall under the standard policy reserve using the FSA-notified standard valuation interest rate and standard mortality table, and which use a basic-document method.
Produce a one-page product fact card per product showing the guaranteed benefits, the minimum guarantee charge, the surrender charge schedule and the reserved basis behind the guarantee.
Refresh the cards whenever the filed calculation method changes and date-stamp each version.
checklist.done: every in-scope product has a dated fact card stating its guaranteed benefits and the Art. 116 basis reserving them.

checklist.step: Open the case with the profile, illustration and application together
actions: Take the case from the queue and confirm it carries the intention sheet, the profile, the illustration version and the draft application.
Reject incomplete cases back to the producer the same day with the missing item named.
Note the producer code, channel and whether the case is a replacement or a new relationship.
Start the 2-business-day clock, or the same-day clock for replacement cases.
checklist.done: the case is complete, categorised and clocked, or returned the same day with the missing item named.

checklist.step: Test the product against the customer's stated purpose
actions: Read the purpose text from the intention sheet and state in the case notes what the customer said they wanted.
Compare the product's core function — accumulation with a minimum guarantee, income for life, death benefit — to that purpose.
Where the purpose is protection and the product is accumulation-led, record the mismatch and refer rather than approve.
Record the comparison against at least one simpler or cheaper alternative from the product shelf, naming it.
checklist.done: the case notes state the customer's purpose, the product's function, and a named cheaper alternative considered.

checklist.step: Test affordability and concentration against the recorded finances
actions: Compute premium as a percentage of recorded annual income for regular premium cases and as a percentage of liquid assets for single premium cases.
Compare both to the desk concentration guidelines and record the computed values, not just a pass flag.
Check the customer retains an emergency reserve after the premium, using the recorded liquid asset figure.
Refer any case above guideline to the supervisor with the computed figures attached.
checklist.done: the case records computed affordability and concentration percentages and any breach is referred with the figures.

checklist.step: Check the illustration is consistent with the filed reserve basis
actions: Compare the guaranteed values on the illustration to the guaranteed values supported by the product's Art. 116 reserved basis on the fact card.
Confirm the illustration used the current filed premium rate and the current minimum guarantee charge, not a superseded version.
Confirm any non-guaranteed projection is labelled as such and uses a rate within the approved illustration range.
Reject to Product any illustration whose guaranteed values exceed what the filed basis reserves — that is a basic-document conflict, not a presentation issue.
checklist.done: the illustration's guaranteed values, premium rate and guarantee charge all agree with the current filed basis.

checklist.step: Apply extra scrutiny to replacements and switches
actions: Identify from the customer record and the application whether an existing contract is being surrendered or reduced to fund the new one.
Pull the existing contract's surrender value, surrender charge remaining, guaranteed rate and any benefit that would be lost.
Build the side-by-side comparison of the old and new contracts across cost, guarantees and charges over the customer's stated horizon.
Decline where the customer gives up a higher guaranteed rate for no demonstrated benefit, and record the arithmetic behind the call.
checklist.done: every replacement case carries a side-by-side comparison and a decision supported by the surrender and guarantee arithmetic.

checklist.step: Apply the vulnerability and age overlays
actions: Flag cases where the customer is above the desk's senior age threshold, where the surrender charge period extends beyond a plausible horizon, or where a vulnerability indicator was recorded.
Require a second signature from a supervisor and, for senior cases, evidence that a family member or supporter was present or offered.
Record the extra steps taken rather than simply raising the flag.
Decline where the surrender charge period materially exceeds the customer's stated horizon and no adequate reason is recorded.
checklist.done: every flagged case shows the extra steps taken and a second supervisory signature.

checklist.step: Record the decision with a written rationale
actions: Set the decision code and write a rationale that names the purpose, the fit, the affordability figures and the alternative considered.
Attach the illustration version id, the fact card version and the profile capture id to the decision.
Never record a rationale that would read identically for a different customer — the customer's own facts must appear in it.
Release the decision to the new business queue with the code visible.
checklist.done: each case carries a coded decision, a customer-specific written rationale and links to the illustration, fact card and profile.

checklist.step: Escalate contested and borderline decisions
actions: Take referrals and producer appeals against declines within 2 business days.
Re-perform the fit and affordability tests independently before ruling, rather than reviewing the analyst's note.
Record the ruling, the reasoning and whether the original decision is upheld or overturned.
Track overturn rates by analyst and by producer and investigate any producer whose appeals are routinely upheld.
checklist.done: every referral and appeal is ruled within 2 business days with an independent re-performance recorded.

checklist.step: Stop the application where the recommendation fails
actions: Configure new business acceptance to require an approved or conditionally approved suitability decision id on the application.
Reject any application whose decision is declined or absent, returning the decision reference to the producer.
Where a condition was attached, confirm the condition is satisfied and evidenced before acceptance.
Log every rejection with the decision code so producer patterns are visible.
checklist.done: no in-scope application is accepted without an approved decision id and satisfied conditions.

checklist.step: Tell the customer what was decided and why, where it affects them
actions: Where a recommendation is declined or altered, write to the customer explaining what changed and why, in plain language.
For replacement declines, state the specific benefit they would have lost.
Record the letter and the date sent on the case file.
Handle any resulting complaint through the complaints process rather than reopening the case informally.
checklist.done: every declined or altered recommendation has a dated plain-language letter on the case file.

checklist.step: Monitor decision quality across the desk
actions: Report weekly on approval rate by analyst, decline rate by producer, replacement volume, average rationale length and the share of rationales reusing identical wording.
Investigate any analyst approving at a materially higher rate than the desk average.
Investigate any producer whose replacement share exceeds the channel average by a wide margin.
Feed findings into the analyst calibration session held monthly.
checklist.done: weekly metrics are published and every outlier analyst or producer has an open investigation.

checklist.step: Calibrate the desk on real cases every month
actions: Take five recent cases including at least one decline and one replacement and have every analyst decide them blind.
Compare the decisions and discuss every divergence against the published question set.
Update the procedure or the guidance where the divergence came from an ambiguity rather than an error.
Record attendance and the outcomes as training evidence.
checklist.done: a monthly calibration record shows the cases used, the divergences and any guidance change.

checklist.step: Retain the suitability case file
actions: File the case — profile, illustration, fact card version, comparison worksheets, decision, rationale and any customer letter — against the policy or application number.
Apply the contract-life-plus-5-years retention label.
Confirm retrieval by policy number, producer code, analyst and decision code works in a single search.
Link the case to any complaint or remediation raised on the same policy.
checklist.done: each case file is complete, labelled for contract life plus 5 years and retrievable by policy, producer and decision code.

testing.step: Build the population of decisions and accepted applications
actions: Extract every suitability case decided in the quarter with decision code, analyst, producer, channel and decision timestamp.
Extract every in-scope application accepted into underwriting in the quarter from the policy administration system.
Hold both populations — the second exists to expose accepted applications with no decision.
Sign and date both extracts as complete.
testing.done: both populations are extracted, dated and signed, covering decisions and accepted applications separately.

testing.step: Reconcile accepted applications to recorded decisions
actions: Join accepted applications to decisions on application id.
List any accepted application with no decision, with a declined decision, or with a decision timestamped after acceptance as automatic exceptions.
Confirm conditionally approved cases carry evidence the condition was satisfied before acceptance.
Report counts by channel and producer.
testing.done: every accepted application matches a pre-dated approved decision or appears on the exception list.

testing.step: Draw a documented sample of decisions
actions: Take 100% of replacement cases, 100% of overturned appeals and 100% of senior or vulnerability-flagged cases.
Take 25 approvals at random with a recorded seed across all analysts, minimum 45 cases in total.
Record population size, seed, sample size and selection date.
Ensure every deciding analyst appears in the sample.
testing.done: the sample is reproducible, covers every analyst and includes all replacement, overturned and flagged cases.

testing.step: Re-perform the best-interest decision independently
actions: For each sampled case read the profile and the illustration and reach your own decision against the published question set before opening the analyst's rationale.
Compare your decision to the recorded one; a difference in outcome, and a right outcome supported by the wrong reasoning, are both exceptions.
Check the rationale names the customer's own purpose, the computed affordability figures and a named alternative.
Record the re-performance note in the workpaper for every sampled case.
testing.done: each sampled case has an independent decision and a documented comparison to the recorded one.

testing.step: Trace illustrated guarantees to the filed Art. 116 reserve basis
actions: For each sampled case, open the illustration and read the guaranteed values, the premium rate and the minimum guarantee charge.
Open the product's filed basic-document reserve method and confirm the guaranteed values are supported by the valuation interest rate and mortality basis actually reserved.
Confirm standard-reserve products used the FSA-notified standard valuation interest rate and standard mortality table in force at issue.
An illustrated guarantee exceeding the reserved basis is a reportable breach, not a test exception.
testing.done: every sampled illustration's guarantees are supported by the filed reserve basis in force at issue.

testing.step: Recompute the affordability and concentration arithmetic
actions: Recompute premium as a percentage of recorded income and of recorded liquid assets from the profile figures.
Compare to the values recorded on the case and to the desk guidelines.
Confirm every guideline breach was referred to the supervisor before approval.
A recomputed breach that was never referred is an exception regardless of the final outcome.
testing.done: affordability and concentration recompute for every sampled case and every breach shows a prior referral.

testing.step: Re-perform the replacement comparison
actions: For each replacement case, pull the surrendered contract's surrender value, remaining surrender charge, guaranteed rate and lost benefits from the administration system.
Rebuild the cost and guarantee comparison over the customer's stated horizon independently.
Compare your conclusion to the recorded decision and flag any case where a higher guaranteed rate was given up without a demonstrated benefit.
Confirm the customer letter was sent where the recommendation was declined or altered.
testing.done: every replacement decision is independently rebuilt and any unjustified give-up of a guarantee is flagged.

testing.step: Test decision timeliness and queue integrity
actions: Recompute elapsed business days from case creation to decision and compare to the 2-business-day standard, and same-day for replacements.
Check no case was closed and re-opened to reset the clock, using the case audit trail.
Recompute appeal turnaround against the 2-business-day standard.
List every breach of the service standard with its elapsed days.
testing.done: elapsed days recompute for every sampled case and no clock reset appears in the audit trail.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise one case per exception with the policy or application number, analyst, producer and the specific failure.

Assign a root cause from the fixed list: decision absent, rationale generic, affordability breach unreferred, replacement comparison missing, illustration inconsistent with the filed basis, clock reset.
Name an owner and a remediation date, and open customer remediation where a policy issued on an absent or overturned decision.
Carry every open case into the next quarter's test as a mandatory retest row.
testing.done: each exception has a case, a root cause, an owner, a remediation date and a retest commitment.

testing.step: Conclude, obtain independent sign-off and report
actions: Compute the exception rate by analyst and by producer against the zero-tolerance threshold for an accepted application with no decision.
State the conclusion — effective, effective with exceptions, or ineffective — with workpaper references.
Have the reviewer, who decided no sampled case and supervises no deciding analyst, sign and date the workpaper.
Report to the Compliance Committee and escalate any illustration-versus-reserve-basis breach to the Appointed Actuary and the Board; file the workpaper in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper states exception rates by analyst and producer, a conclusion and the reporting dates.

checklist.step: Define the curriculum tier each product demands
actions: Map every product on the shelf to a tier: basic protection, medical and living benefits, savings-type, and specified insurance contracts including variable annuities.
For each tier list the mandatory items: the general solicitor course, the applied course, the product-specific module, and for specified contracts the variable insurance sales qualification.
State the pass mark and the validity period for each item and where the certificate comes from.
Have the Head of Compliance approve the map and publish it as the entitlement rule set.
checklist.done: every product maps to an approved tier with named mandatory items, pass marks and validity periods.

checklist.step: Verify solicitor registration before anything else
actions: For each new solicitor or agency, record the registration number, the registering entity, the effective date and the product categories the registration covers.
Confirm the registration is live and covers life insurance solicitation for the company before creating a producer code.
For agency staff, confirm the agency's own registration and the individual's affiliation with it are both current.
Reject onboarding where registration is pending — a producer code must not exist ahead of registration.
checklist.done: no producer code exists without a verified live registration covering the products to be solicited.

checklist.step: Assign the curriculum and hold the entitlement closed
actions: On producer code creation, auto-assign the tier curriculum from the entitlement rule set with a completion due date.
Leave the solicitation entitlement flag closed in the producer management system until every mandatory item is complete.
Send the producer the learning plan with the items, the due dates and the consequence of non-completion.
Notify the producer's manager of the assignment so the field knows the producer cannot yet sell.
checklist.done: each new producer has an assigned curriculum, a due date, a notified manager and a closed entitlement flag.

checklist.step: Deliver the product training with an assessment that can fail people
actions: Deliver the module covering the product's guarantees, charges, surrender charge schedule, the customer profiling duty and the prohibited solicitation acts.
Set an assessment with a stated pass mark and a limited number of attempts, recording the score on every attempt.
For specified contracts, cover the investment risk disclosure and the pre-contract document requirements explicitly.
Record attendance for instructor-led sessions against the producer code, not against a name.
checklist.done: each producer has a scored assessment result against their producer code with attempts recorded.

checklist.step: Gate variable annuity selling on the specialist qualification
actions: Require the variable insurance sales qualification certificate for any producer selling specified insurance contracts, recording the certificate number and issue date.
Store the expiry or renewal date and set the entitlement to variable products to expire with it.
Confirm the certificate is genuine against the issuing body's record rather than accepting a scan alone.
Leave the variable product entitlement closed until the certificate is recorded and verified.
checklist.done: no producer holds a variable product entitlement without a verified qualification certificate and recorded expiry.

checklist.step: Open the entitlement only when every item is satisfied
actions: Run the nightly synchronisation from the LMS and set the entitlement flag per product tier only where every mandatory item shows complete and in date.
Record the entitlement change with a timestamp, the triggering item and the operator or job that made it.
Publish the entitlement to the quotation and application systems so the block bites at point of sale.
Report any synchronisation failure to the Producer Compliance Manager the same morning — a failed sync must fail closed.
checklist.done: entitlements are set only on complete, in-date curricula, with a timestamped change history and a fail-closed sync.

checklist.step: Block the sale at the point of solicitation
actions: Configure the portal so the product list a producer sees is filtered by their live entitlement — an unentitled product cannot be quoted, not merely warned against.
Configure the application submission check to re-validate entitlement against the solicitation date, not the submission date.
Show the producer the reason and the missing item when a product is unavailable to them.
Log every blocked attempt with producer code, product and timestamp.
checklist.done: unentitled products are unquotable in the portal and every blocked attempt is logged.

checklist.step: Track expiries and continuing education deadlines per producer
actions: Maintain per producer the registration renewal date, the qualification expiry and the annual continuing education deadline.
Fire reminders to producer and manager at 60, 30 and 7 days before each date.
Escalate to the regional manager at 7 days with the list of producers who will lose entitlement.
Report the forward 90-day expiry pipeline weekly to Distribution leadership.
checklist.done: every producer has tracked dates, three-stage reminders and a weekly 90-day expiry pipeline report.

checklist.step: Suspend entitlement automatically on the expiry date
actions: Run the suspension job daily so any lapsed registration, qualification or continuing education closes the entitlement that day, without manual intervention.
Notify the producer, the manager and Distribution Compliance of every suspension with the reason.
Confirm the suspension propagated to the portal by checking the affected product is no longer quotable for that producer.
Record the suspension in the entitlement change history.
checklist.done: every lapse produces a same-day automatic suspension, a notification and a verified portal block.

checklist.step: Reinstate only on evidence, never on assurance
actions: Require the completion record, certificate or renewed registration as a document before reinstating.
Check the document's dates cover the period going forward, and note the lapse period explicitly.
Reinstate through the same controlled job that suspends, so the change history shows both.
Investigate any sale dated inside the lapse period before reinstatement is completed.
checklist.done: each reinstatement is evidenced by a dated document, recorded in the change history, and preceded by a lapse-period sales check.

checklist.step: Reconcile sales against entitlement every week
actions: Join the week's policies to the entitlement change history on producer code and solicitation date.
List every policy solicited on a date when the producer lacked the entitlement for that product tier.
Publish the list to the Producer Compliance Manager and the Head of Compliance the same day.
Keep the query and its output versioned so a historic week can be re-run unchanged.
checklist.done: a weekly reconciliation lists every sale made without a matching live entitlement, published same day.

checklist.step: Handle agency panels and their staff turnover
actions: Require each agency to notify joiners and leavers within 5 business days and reconcile their staff list to your producer records monthly.
Close entitlements for leavers on notification and investigate any sale after their departure date.
For multi-carrier agencies, confirm your product training is completed even where the agency has trained on a competitor's equivalent.
Record the monthly reconciliation and any discrepancy with the agency's response.
checklist.done: each agency's staff list reconciles monthly to producer records with leavers' entitlements closed on notification.

checklist.step: Feed monitoring findings back into the training
actions: Take the quarter's complaints, mis-selling findings and suitability declines by theme from Market Conduct.
Rewrite or add training content addressing the top three themes, naming the behaviour to change.
Assign the revised module to the producers and channels the findings came from, with a deadline.
Measure whether the theme's finding rate falls in the following quarter and report it.
checklist.done: the top three conduct themes each have revised content, a targeted assignment and a measured follow-up rate.

checklist.step: Report solicitation control system performance to the committee
actions: Table quarterly the entitlement compliance rate, the lapse count, sales-during-lapse count, training completion rate and the reconciliation exceptions.
Name the agencies and channels driving exceptions rather than reporting a panel average.
Record the committee's directed actions with owners and due dates.
Escalate to the Board any sale made by an unregistered producer.
checklist.done: the committee minute records channel-level performance, named drivers and directed actions with owners.

checklist.step: Retain the producer eligibility record
actions: File per producer the registration record, course completions with scores and dates, qualification certificates and the entitlement change history.
Apply the retention label of 5 years after panel departure.
Confirm retrieval by producer code, registration number and product tier works in a single search.
Link the record to any conduct breach raised against that producer.
checklist.done: each producer record is complete, labelled for 5 years after departure and retrievable by producer code and registration number.

testing.step: Build the population of producers and their sales
actions: Extract every producer active on the Japan panel at any point in the quarter with producer code, registration number, channel and agency.
Extract every policy solicited in the quarter with producer code, product tier and solicitation date.
Reconcile the sales count to the new business production report and the producer count to the panel report.
Sign and date both extracts as complete.
testing.done: both extracts are reconciled to the production and panel reports and signed as complete.

testing.step: Reconcile every sale to a live entitlement on the solicitation date
actions: Rebuild the entitlement-versus-sale join independently rather than using the operational weekly report.
For each sale, test whether the producer held a live entitlement for that product tier on the solicitation date using the entitlement change history.
List every failing sale with producer, product, date and the missing item.
Compare your list to the operational weekly reports and explain any sale the operational report missed.
testing.done: an independent join lists every sale without a live entitlement and reconciles to the operational reports.

testing.step: Draw a documented sample of producer files
actions: Take 100% of producers with a lapse, a suspension or a failing sale in the quarter.
Take 40 further producers at random with a recorded seed, stratified across employed solicitors and agency staff.
Record population size, seed, sample size and selection date.
Include every producer newly onboarded in the quarter selling specified contracts.
testing.done: the sample is reproducible, stratified by channel and covers all lapse and new specified-contract producers.

testing.step: Verify registration for each sampled producer at source
actions: For each sampled producer, take the recorded registration number and verify it against the registering body's record rather than the internal field.
Confirm the registration was live across the whole quarter and covers life insurance solicitation for this company.
For agency staff, confirm both the agency registration and the individual affiliation were live.
A producer code active while registration was not live is a reportable breach, not a test exception.
testing.done: every sampled producer's registration is verified at source as live and in scope across the quarter.

testing.step: Re-perform the curriculum completeness check
actions: Take the approved entitlement rule set and independently list the mandatory items for each sampled producer's entitled tiers.
Pull the LMS transcript and confirm every item is complete, in date, and passed at the stated pass mark.
Check the completion date pre-dates the entitlement opening date in the producer management system.
An entitlement opened before the last completion date is an exception in the synchronisation control.
testing.done: each sampled producer's transcript covers every mandatory item, passed and completed before entitlement opened.

testing.step: Verify the variable insurance sales qualification certificates
actions: For every sampled producer holding a variable product entitlement, open the stored qualification certificate.
Verify the certificate number and issue date against the issuing body's record.
Confirm the recorded expiry matches the certificate and that the variable entitlement expires with it.
A variable entitlement without a verified certificate, or outliving it, is a reportable breach.
testing.done: every sampled variable entitlement is backed by a source-verified certificate whose expiry governs the entitlement.

testing.step: Recompute the lapse and suspension timing
actions: For each lapse in the quarter, recompute the expiry date from the source document — registration renewal, certificate expiry or continuing education deadline.
Compare it to the suspension timestamp in the entitlement change history and record the days of delay.
Recompute whether the 60/30/7-day reminders actually fired by checking the notification log.
List every sale falling inside a lapse window with the days of exposure.
testing.done: every lapse shows a recomputed expiry, a measured suspension delay, evidenced reminders and any in-window sales.

testing.step: Test that the portal block genuinely bites
actions: With a controlled test producer code lacking the variable entitlement, attempt to quote a variable annuity in the portal.
Confirm the product is absent from the list rather than merely warned against, and that submission is refused.
Repeat after granting and then suspending the entitlement to confirm the block follows the change within the stated sync window.
Capture screenshots of each attempt into the workpaper.
testing.done: the portal block is demonstrated absent-not-warned in both the unentitled and the suspended states, with screenshots.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise one issue per exception with producer code, agency, the missing item and the policies affected.
Assign a root cause from the fixed list: registration not verified, entitlement opened early, sync failed open, suspension job late, agency leaver not notified, certificate unverified.
Name an owner and a remediation date, and decide with Regulatory Counsel how policies sold during a lapse are treated.
Carry every open issue into the next quarter's test as a mandatory retest row.
testing.done: each exception has an issue, a root cause, an owner, a remediation date and a decision on affected policies.

testing.step: Conclude, obtain independent sign-off and report
actions: Compute the entitlement exception rate over 100% of sales and the file exception rate over the sampled producers.
State the conclusion — effective, effective with exceptions, or ineffective — with workpaper references.
Have the reviewer, who sits outside Distribution and maintains no producer record, sign and date the workpaper.
Report to the Compliance Committee, escalate any sale by an unregistered producer to the Board, and file the workpaper in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper states both exception rates, a conclusion and the committee reporting date.

checklist.step: Fix which disclosure documents each product tier must carry
actions: List every Japan-issued product on the shelf and tag it protection, savings-type, or specified insurance contract (Variable Annuities and other market-linked products).

Against each tag record the mandatory set: Contract Summary, Information Requiring Attention sheet, policy illustration, cooling-off notice, and for specified contracts the additional risk, fee and minimum guarantee disclosure.

Cite the source for each requirement on the row — Insurance Business Act Art. 294 with Ordinance for Enforcement Art. 227-2 for the Contract Summary and attention items, Art. 309 for the cooling-off notice.
Have Regulatory Counsel confirm the mapping in writing and publish it as the disclosure entitlement rule set to Distribution.
checklist.done: every product carries a counsel-confirmed list of mandatory disclosure documents with the citation behind each one.

checklist.step: Draft the Contract Summary content against the prescribed heads
actions: Draft the Contract Summary covering each prescribed head: name and type of contract, the benefits payable and the events that trigger them, the policy term and premium payment period, the premium and how it is set, the surrender value pattern, and any dividend treatment.
Pull the benefit definitions verbatim from the approved general policy conditions rather than paraphrasing them into marketing language.

For Variable Annuities add the separate account investment options, the fee stack (acquisition, administration, asset management, minimum guarantee charge) with each rate stated separately, and the annuitisation options.
Send the draft to the Product / Filing Actuary to confirm the figures agree with the premium and policy-reserve calculation methods in the basic documents.
checklist.done: the Contract Summary covers every prescribed head with wording drawn from the approved conditions and actuarially confirmed figures.

checklist.step: Draft the Information Requiring Attention sheet so the downside is unmissable
actions: Draft the attention items: the duty of disclosure at underwriting and the consequence of misstatement (rescission), the grace period and lapse, the reinstatement conditions, exclusions and non-payment events, surrender charges and the loss on early surrender, and the 8-day cooling-off right under Art. 309.

For Variable Annuities add in the same size type: principal is not guaranteed, the customer bears investment risk, the minimum guarantee applies only on the stated conditions, and the guarantee charge is deducted whether or not the guarantee ever pays.
Set the risk items in a bordered block ahead of the benefit narrative, not in a footnote, and keep the type size no smaller than the surrounding body text.
Route the draft to Regulatory Counsel for an Art. 300 check that no statement is misleading and no material fact is omitted.
checklist.done: the attention sheet carries every prescribed risk item in prominent type with a counsel Art. 300 clearance recorded.

checklist.step: Refresh the company soundness figures the disclosure set must show
actions: After the March 31 business year end, take the published solvency margin ratio, the Art. 115 price fluctuation reserve closing balance, the Art. 116 policy reserve balance and the net assets figure from the Art. 111 disclosure document.

Within 10 business days of that publication, hand the figures with their as-of date to the Marketing Compliance Analyst for insertion into the Contract Summary and the variable annuity pre-contract document.
Record the source page reference for each figure so a solicitor asked in the field can be pointed at the published document.
Diary the next refresh for the following June and flag any interim (September 30) movement large enough to warrant an out-of-cycle update.
checklist.done: the disclosure set carries current solvency margin ratio and reserve figures with their as-of date and a traced source reference.

checklist.step: Version-stamp and release the disclosure documents into the sales systems
actions: Assign each approved document a version code of the form <product code>-<document type>-<yyyymmdd> and stamp it into the PDF footer on every page.
Publish the approved versions to the policy administration quote template library, the Broker & Agent Portal download area and the tied-agency tablet package on the same release date.
Withdraw the superseded version the same day and set the system to refuse it — a withdrawn version must not remain printable from any channel.
Circulate the release note naming the version, the effective date and what changed to the Head of Distribution and every channel manager.
checklist.done: one current version per document is live across all channels on a single release date and superseded versions cannot be printed.

checklist.step: Generate the customer-specific disclosure pack at the point of quote
actions: In the policy administration quote screen enter the customer's age, sex, sum insured, premium, term and, for Variable Annuities, the selected separate account funds.
Generate the pack: Contract Summary, Information Requiring Attention sheet, illustration and cooling-off notice, each carrying the current version stamp and the quote number.
Check the illustration shows the surrender value by policy year and, for Variable Annuities, the prescribed low, mid and high return scenarios with the fee drag already deducted.
Reject and regenerate any pack where the version stamp is not today's live version rather than delivering it and correcting later.
checklist.done: a quote-specific pack exists on the current version stamp with a scenario illustration net of fees.

checklist.step: Deliver and explain the pack before the application is signed
actions: Hand or transmit the pack to the customer and walk through the attention sheet item by item before any application form is produced.
For Variable Annuities state aloud and record that principal is not guaranteed, that the customer bears the investment risk, and what the total annual charge is as a percentage.
Answer questions on exclusions, surrender charges and the cooling-off right, and note any question the customer asked on the solicitation record.
Never present the application form first — the disclosure timestamp must precede the application timestamp in the system record.
checklist.done: the solicitation record shows the pack delivered and explained, timestamped before the application was produced.

checklist.step: Capture the customer's dated acknowledgement of receipt
actions: Send the acknowledgement page for electronic signature, or take the paper receipt slip signed and dated in the customer's hand.
Confirm the acknowledgement names both the Contract Summary and the Information Requiring Attention sheet by title and version code, not a generic 'documents received'.
For Variable Annuities capture the separate acknowledgement that the customer understands principal is not guaranteed and has read the fee table.
Upload the signed acknowledgement against the quote number the same day so New Business can find it without chasing.
checklist.done: a dated acknowledgement naming both documents by title and version is attached to the quote within one business day.

checklist.step: Deliver the cooling-off notice and start the 8-day clock correctly
actions: Confirm the written cooling-off notice under Art. 309 was delivered, stating the 8-day period, the postmark rule and the address to send the withdrawal to.
Record the later of the cooling-off notice delivery date and the application date as the clock start and let the system compute the expiry date.
Flag any contract where the notice date is missing — the clock has not started and the contract cannot be treated as beyond withdrawal.
Suppress the first premium application to the separate account for Variable Annuities until the clock start date is recorded.
checklist.done: every contract shows a recorded cooling-off clock start, a computed expiry date and a delivered notice.

checklist.step: Gate new business acceptance on complete disclosure evidence
actions: At case acceptance run the disclosure completeness check: acknowledgement present, acknowledgement date on or before application date, version code equal to the version live on the delivery date, cooling-off notice date present.
Return any case failing the check to the solicitor as 'not in good order' with the specific missing element named, rather than issuing and chasing.
Refuse to override the gate on volume or month-end pressure; an override requires the Market Conduct / Consumer Compliance Manager's written approval on the case.
Record the check result on the policy record so it is visible to Audit later.
checklist.done: no policy issues without a passed disclosure completeness check or a named written override.

checklist.step: Apply the specified-insurance-contract overlay to Variable Annuity sales
actions: For each Variable Annuity case confirm the specified-insurance-contract pre-contract document was delivered in addition to the Contract Summary, covering the fee stack, the surrender charge schedule and the minimum guarantee conditions.
Check the illustration's assumed return set matches the currently approved scenario set and that no bespoke return assumption was typed in by the solicitor.
Confirm the customer's stated investment experience and risk tolerance from the profile record are consistent with the fund selection shown in the pack.
Escalate any case where the customer is aged 70 or over to the second-person confirmation process before issue.
checklist.done: every Variable Annuity case has the additional pre-contract document, an approved scenario set and, where applicable, a completed elderly second-person confirmation.

checklist.step: Monitor delivery quality across channels each month
actions: Build a monthly dashboard of acknowledgement completion rate, average days from delivery to acknowledgement, stale-version delivery count and gate-override count, split by channel and solicitor.
Rank solicitors by defect rate and refer anyone above the agreed tolerance to the Producer Compliance Manager for coaching or suspension.
Compare the bank-window channel separately — its handover to a tied solicitor is the common point of failure.
Publish the dashboard to the Head of Distribution and the Head of Compliance by working day 10.
checklist.done: a channel and solicitor level disclosure-defect dashboard is published monthly with named referrals for outliers.

checklist.step: Mine complaints for disclosure failures the controls did not catch
actions: Filter the complaint register for causes indicating a disclosure failure: 'was not told about surrender charge', 'believed principal was guaranteed', 'not told about exclusions', 'did not know about cooling-off'.
For each, pull the policy's disclosure bundle and check whether the document was delivered and what it actually said on the point complained of.
Where the pack was delivered and clear, record the finding as a comprehension issue and feed it to Marketing Compliance for wording improvement.
Where the pack was missing or defective, open a remediation case and refer any Financial ADR referral from the Life Insurance Association of Japan to Regulatory Counsel.
checklist.done: every disclosure-themed complaint is tested against the actual delivered pack and routed to wording improvement or remediation.

checklist.step: Remediate customers where disclosure failed
actions: For each confirmed failure decide the remedy: re-deliver the pack with a fresh acknowledgement, reinstate the 8-day cooling-off window from the re-delivery date, or unwind the contract with premium refund.
Set the population boundary — where the cause was a stale document version or a system defect, remediate every contract sold on that version, not only the complainant.
Approve the customer letter wording with Regulatory Counsel before it is sent and record the mailing date and response tracking.
Report the remediation population, cost and completion rate to the Board Risk Committee and decide with counsel whether an FSA notification is warranted.
checklist.done: each failure has an approved remedy, a defined remediation population, sent customer communications and a recorded FSA notification decision.

checklist.step: File the per-policy disclosure bundle for the retention period
actions: Assemble per policy: the version-stamped Contract Summary and Information Requiring Attention sheet actually shown, the illustration, the cooling-off notice, the dated acknowledgement and the solicitation record.
Store the bundle against the policy number with the solicitor registration number and the channel as searchable attributes.
Apply the 10-years-from-termination retention label so the record survives surrender, annuitisation and death claim closure.
Run a quarterly completeness sweep for policies with no bundle and refer each gap to the Market Conduct / Consumer Compliance Manager.
checklist.done: every issued policy has a complete searchable bundle under a 10-year retention label, with gaps referred quarterly.

testing.step: Build the population of Japan-issued contracts for the quarter
actions: Extract every contract with an issue date inside the quarter from the new business register, with policy number, product code, product tier, channel, solicitor registration number, application date and issue date.
Flag Variable Annuity contracts as specified insurance contracts and bank-window sales as a separate stratum.
Reconcile the extract count and premium to the quarter's new business production report from the Distribution Operations Manager and clear any difference before sampling.
Sign the population sheet as complete and note any channel absent from the extract as a scoping exception.
testing.done: the population reconciles to the new business production report by count and premium and is signed as complete.

testing.step: Reconcile disclosure bundles to the population before sampling
actions: Join the population to the document repository on policy number and list every contract with no disclosure bundle at all.
List every contract whose acknowledgement date is missing, or later than the application date, from the system fields without opening the documents.
Treat both lists as automatic exceptions carried into the sample at 100% rather than as candidates for judgement.
Report the raw completeness percentage before any sampling so the headline number cannot be diluted by sampling.
testing.done: the population-level completeness rate is stated and every missing or late-acknowledged contract is captured as an automatic exception.

testing.step: Draw the sample and record the method
actions: Take 100% of Variable Annuity contracts and 100% of bank-window sales in the quarter.
Take 40 contracts selected at random using a recorded seed from the remaining tiers, stratified to include every channel and the 10 highest-volume solicitors.
Add 100% of contracts where a disclosure gate override was recorded.
Record the seed, strata, population sizes and selection date in the workpaper so the sample can be re-drawn identically.
testing.done: the sample is reproducible, covers all Variable Annuity and bank-window sales, every override, and every channel.

testing.step: Re-perform the document-version check on the delivered pack
actions: Open the actual PDF delivered for each sampled contract and read the version code stamped in the footer.
Compare it to the version release register for the delivery date and confirm it was the live version on that date, not a superseded one.
Check the printed solvency margin ratio and reserve figures match the Art. 111 disclosure document in force at delivery and are not carried over from the prior business year.
Log any stale version or stale figure as a content exception with the delivery date and the correct version identified.
testing.done: every sampled pack is confirmed on the version live at delivery with current soundness figures, or the defect is logged.

testing.step: Re-perform the prescribed-content check against Art. 227-2 heads
actions: Read each sampled Contract Summary against the prescribed heads — contract type, benefits and triggering events, term and premium payment period, premium basis, surrender value and dividend treatment — ticking each head found.
Read each Information Requiring Attention sheet for the duty of disclosure and rescission consequence, grace and lapse, reinstatement, exclusions, surrender charge and the 8-day cooling-off right.
For Variable Annuities confirm the fee stack is broken out by charge with a rate against each, and that the no-principal-guarantee and minimum guarantee wording appears in the prominent block.
Score any missing head as a content fail — a document that is present but silent on a prescribed head is not compliant delivery.
testing.done: each sampled document is scored head by head with every missing prescribed item recorded as a content fail.

testing.step: Trace acknowledgement and sequencing to the system record
actions: Open the signed acknowledgement for each sampled contract and confirm it names both the Contract Summary and the Information Requiring Attention sheet by title and version code.
Read the electronic signature certificate (or the paper slip date) and compare the signature timestamp to the application timestamp in policy administration.
Confirm the customer signature, not the solicitor's, carries the date, and that no acknowledgement was signed in bulk on a later day.
Log any acknowledgement dated after the application, or naming the documents generically, as a delivery-sequence exception.
testing.done: each sampled acknowledgement is customer-dated, names both documents by version, and pre-dates the application.

testing.step: Recompute the cooling-off clock and check the premium handling
actions: For each sampled contract, take the cooling-off notice delivery date and the application date and recompute the 8-day expiry from the later of the two under Art. 309.
Compare your computed expiry to the expiry held on the policy record and record any difference in days.
For Variable Annuities check the first premium was not applied to the separate account before the clock start date was recorded.
Check any withdrawal received in the quarter was honoured on the postmark date rather than the receipt date, and that the premium was refunded in full.
testing.done: every sampled cooling-off expiry reconciles to the recomputed date and every withdrawal received was honoured on postmark with a full refund.

testing.step: Test the specified-insurance-contract overlay on Variable Annuity sales
actions: Confirm the additional pre-contract document was delivered alongside the Contract Summary for every Variable Annuity contract in the quarter.
Re-run the illustration for 10 contracts using the approved scenario set and compare the surrender values and account values shown to those in the delivered pack.

Check the fund selection in the pack against the customer's recorded investment experience and risk tolerance, and confirm the elderly second-person confirmation exists for every customer aged 70 or over.
Treat a hand-typed return assumption or a missing elderly confirmation as a fail, not a documentation note.
testing.done: every Variable Annuity sale carries the additional document, a reproducible illustration and the required elderly confirmation.

testing.step: Log exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation
actions: Raise a GRC issue per exception recording policy number, solicitor registration number, channel, the Article breached (Art. 294, Art. 227-2 head, or Art. 309) and whether the customer was disadvantaged.
Assign a root cause from the agreed list (stale version live in channel, acknowledgement taken after application, gate overridden, content head missing, notice not delivered) and an owner.
Set the customer remedy on the issue — re-disclosure, cooling-off reinstatement from re-delivery, or unwind with refund — and a remediation date.
Where a stale version or system defect caused the exception, expand the issue to every contract sold on that version and carry all open issues into next quarter's test as mandatory retest rows.
testing.done: every exception has an issue with the Article breached, a root cause, an owner, a customer remedy, a remediation date and a defined expanded population where relevant.

testing.step: Conclude, obtain independent sign-off and report
actions: Compute the exception rate by tier and channel and compare to the stated thresholds — zero tolerance on missing acknowledgement, zero tolerance on content defects, three fails at one solicitor triggering suspension.
Write the conclusion — effective / effective with exceptions / ineffective — with the workpaper references behind each judgement and the remediation population size where failures were systemic.
Have the independent reviewer, who sits outside Distribution and handled no sampled sale, sign the workpaper.
Report the conclusion, solicitor suspensions and any FSA notification decision to the Board Audit Committee at its next sitting and file the signed workpaper in the compliance evidence repository.
testing.done: a signed workpaper exists with exception rates by channel, a stated conclusion, suspension decisions and a dated Board Audit Committee reporting entry.
